4863-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4863-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

625-1008-1978.easyPrerequisites: Undermountain Adventurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
625-1008-1978.description:
Cause Undermountain Adventurer to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding six {G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Undermountain Adventurer.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3033-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3033-4247-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

728-1981-2415-7918.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

5777-7627-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
5777-7627-7810.description:
Activate Mushroom Watchdogs by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Mushroom Watchdogs ability
Repeat.

4365-5478-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
4365-5478-6441-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2060-3859-7889.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Cavern Harpy spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{B}
Repeat.

2021-2060-6774-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2104-7757-7758-7843.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
2104-7757-7758-7843.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Elrond.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Temporal Manipulation.
Temporal Manipulation's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6147.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6147.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

997-4681-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7509.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Gleeful Arsonist enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Gleeful Arsonist enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

851-907-1558-2638-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-907-1558-2638-4231.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2713-3094-4659-7296-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-7296-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-4120-7315.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4120-7315.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-4120-7315.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3899-7296.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4644-4785-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
4644-4785-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Dynaheir by tapping it.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting the ability from step 1.
Dynaheir triggers. Holding priority, activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Dynaheir's trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Dynaheir's trigger
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6

2781-2921-3817.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3678-4953-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control another nonland permanent.
3678-4953-6879.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Cast Chain of Vapor by paying {U}, causing you to return any nonland permanent you control except Haru or Retreat to Emeria from the battlefield to your hand, and then sacrifice an earthbent land to copy Chain of Vapor targeting another applicable permanent you control.
The earthbent land triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve Chain of Vapor, causing you to return the targeted permanent from the battlefield to your hand, and then sacrifice an earthbent land to copy Chain of Vapor targeting another applicable permanent you control.
Repeat from step 4.

141-5256-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5256-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5256-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

225-1671-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-1671-5451-5702.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

104-671-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-671-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3603-4068-4803-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control at least one Mountain.
3603-4068-4803-5261.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Cloudshift without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

1283-1409-2034-2883.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Twisted Sewer-Witch.
1283-1409-2034-2883.description:
Activate Twisted Sewer-Witch by paying {2}, blinking it.
When Twisted Sewer-Witch enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Twisted Sewer-Witch.
Resolve the Twisted Sewer-Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token, and then creating a Wicked Role Aura token attached to each Rat you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {2}.
The Wicked Role token triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-3633-4147-4294.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2178-3633-4147-4294.notablePrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
"Elder" or "Dinosaur" chosen with Mirror of the Forebears.
It is your precombat main phase.
2178-3633-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mirror of the Forebears by paying {1}, choosing to have it become a copy of Etali until end of turn.
Choose to put Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hua Tuo triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Choose to put Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Etali enters-the-battlefield ability and Hua Tuo trigger.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 7.

413-678-3558.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

401-914-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-914-4050.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R}.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Decaying Soil, causing you to pay {1} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4733-5038-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4733-5038-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Overseer of the Damned triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature sacrificed.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent control.

224-433-2841.description:
During any opponent's turn, activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Activate Ghost Town's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-4535-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-4535-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Good-Fortune Unicorn, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Saproling.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from the Saproling.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Resolve the Ghave ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
